title: Holding rows have no average cost or unrealized PnL or currency though every fill records them
hosted_note: Source-level projection, startup backfill, and BFF contract verification only; no hosted VM deployment, SSH probe, or hosted runtime behaviour is claimed in this evidence.
root_cause: RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore.project_event summed metrics.fill_quantity on paper_fill_simulated into _positions_by_symbol[symbol] and discarded metrics.fill_price, metadata.currency, metadata.broker, and metadata.ledger_fill_count. _rebuild_positions built each position row from symbol, quantity, and _marks_by_symbol without average_price, realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, fill currency fallback, or broker_id.

summary: RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore folds paper_fill_simulated events in per-binding metadata.ledger_fill_count order per symbol using unrounded moving-average cost and realized PnL state (_cost_by_symbol), ignoring repeated ledger_fill_count, buffering out-of-order fills in bounded _cost_pending_fills (max 64) while withholding cost until contiguous from 1, and permanently withholding cost for the binding generation (_cost_withheld = True) on missing/invalid ledger_fill_count or non-positive/non-finite fill_price.

_rebuild_positions populates average_price and realized_pnl on every position row when cost is available, populates unrealized_pnl = quantity * (mark_price - unrounded_average_price) only on accepted non-stale mark rows, rounds to 6 decimals from unrounded state without negative zero (0.0 if rounded == 0.0 else rounded), sets currency from mark quote_currency when present and otherwise from fill metadata.currency, and sets broker_id from fill metadata.broker across all row branches.
Binding rollover clears _cost_by_symbol, _cost_applied_fill_count, _cost_pending_fills, _cost_withheld, _currency_by_symbol, and _broker_by_symbol through keys_to_clear.

TradeEpisodeProjectionStore.retained_paper_fill_events exposes an in-memory deduplicated read of paper_fill_simulated events (deduplicating reversal fills by event_id), and RuntimeSummaryProjectionStore.backfill_open_position_costs runs once at telemetry startup (wired in services/telemetry/main.py and TelemetryIngestService.__init__) for non-retired summaries with open positions and no cost state.
remediation.existing_test_notes: No existing test assertions were weakened or deleted. In test_portfolio_holdings_reproduces_h12_76062_owner_dto_and_governed_calendar_projection, paper_runtime._iso_now and value_portfolio's default now were pinned to the test's existing now_oct25 (2026-10-25T21:41:44Z) and executed_trade_count=2 was included on the pre-seeded 2-fill fixture so it remains deterministic on calendar dates after 2026-10-28 with all original assertions intact.
